correctness.rationale: For each q>=2 the Hermitian determinant polar form is nonsingular; norm character sums yield all three cone Fourier coefficients. Witt index one implies pairwise orthogonality only within the same nonzero isotropic line, giving exact cone Gram eigenvalues q4 (1), q3 ((q2+1)(q−2)), q2 (q2+1). Unitarity of the q4 Fourier matrix transfers nonunit singulars to the invertible complement and supplies the remaining multiplicity s−c+1. Adjugate row-permutation relates polar pairing and trace pairing. The proof is uniform including characteristic two, and the standalone q=2,3,4,5 checker corroborates exact multiplicities without replacing proof.

value.rationale: A natural, geometrically distinguished critically sampled Fourier system on the full rank-two Hermitian locus gains a universal three-level singular spectrum and sharp stability q. Exact injectivity for all finite fields, including characteristic two, is a stronger and mathematically different deliverable from full-space rank-class character sums or finite-field restriction norm bounds. This is useful for reconstruction and matrix rank-stratified Fourier analysis without requiring a higher-dimensional generalization.
